entities.name: Polyphenolic acetophenone substrate
observations: The substrate is represented as CCCc1c(O)ccc(C(C)=O)c1O, containing two phenolic OH groups, an acetyl substituent, and a propyl substituent.
The supplied reaction record supports mono-O-alkylation of this substrate.

entities.name: 3-Bromopropan-1-ol
observations: Acts as the alkylating reagent; its bromide is displaced by a phenoxide nucleophile to install an O-CH2CH2CH2-OH chain.

entities.name: Phenolic O-alkylation
observations: Base-promoted Williamson ether formation gives the mono-(3-hydroxypropyl) aryl ether and retains one free phenolic OH.

entities.name: Mono-hydroxypropyl ether product
observations: The product is the mono-O-(3-hydroxypropyl) ether, not a bromine-containing final product.
